name: Power-Assisted Bicycle
description: A bicycle with handlebars and pedals or hand cranks whose electric motors of 500 W or less, or gas engine of 50 cc or less, stop assisting at 32 km/h; it may have a throttle. A stand-up e-scooter is an electric kick-scooter instead.

restrictions.rule: Steering handlebars, pedals or hand cranks, and two tandem wheels or three wheels with at least one rim of 350 mm or more, or four wheels with at least two
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, s. 3

restrictions.rule: Capable of being propelled by human power, with electric motors totalling 500 W continuous or less, or a gas engine of 50 cc or less, that give no further assistance at 32 km/h on level ground
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, s. 3

restrictions.rule: Needs an on/off switch separate from the throttle, or a mechanism that keeps the motor from engaging below 3 km/h
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, s. 3

restrictions.rule: A bicycle propelled by human and mechanical power, with pedals operable at all times, two tandem wheels or four wheels with rims of 350 mm or more, and an electric motor of 500 W or less, or 50 cc or less, that gives no further assistance at 30 km/h on level ground
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, s. 2(c)(ii)

restrictions.rule: Riders must be 14 or older, and a parent, guardian or owner may not let anyone younger ride one
restrictions.citation: Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, s. 128

restrictions.rule: No minimum age to ride one
Not named in the Act's helmet requirement, which covers bicycles, a class that excludes motor-assisted ones; the regulations' bicycle helmet standard, worn fastened under the chin, applies to it
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, S.N.S. 2025, c. 20, s. 214; Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, s. 3; Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, ss. 114, 115, 116 and 129

restrictions.rule: The rider must wear a bicycle helmet with its chin strap fastened, and a parent or guardian may not let a rider under 16 go without one
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, s. 170A

restrictions.rule: Ridden under the bicycle rules, so a passenger rides only on a permanently attached bicycle seat or a child seat built for them
restrictions.citation: Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, ss. 123 and 129

restrictions.rule: Needs a seat, a brake, a front lamp visible from 100 m, a red rear lamp or reflector visible from 60 m, and a bell or horn
restrictions.citation: Vehicle Equipment, Safety and Inspection Regulations, N.S. Reg. 245/2026, ss. 82, 84 and 85

restrictions.rule: Ridden in the bicycle lane where there is one, otherwise as far right as practicable or on the shoulder, in single file
restrictions.citation: Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, ss. 119, 126 and 129

restrictions.rule: Ridden in the bicycle lane where there is one, otherwise as far right as practicable or on the shoulder, with traffic and in single file
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, s. 171

restrictions.rule: Not ridden on a sidewalk unless a municipal bylaw or traffic control device allows it
restrictions.citation: Using the Road Regulations, N.S. Reg. 230/2026, ss. 121 and 129

restrictions.rule: Not ridden on a sidewalk unless a traffic authority has designated it a trail, though children may ride on one in a public square, park, city or town
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, ss. 171 and 171A

restrictions.rule: A conveyance, not a vehicle: no driver's licence, registration or insurance
restrictions.citation: Traffic Safety Act, S.N.S. 2025, c. 20, ss. 93, 115 and 149; Traffic Safety Act Interpretation Regulations, N.S. Reg. 221/2026, ss. 4 and 5

restrictions.rule: A bicycle, not a motor vehicle: no driver's licence, registration or insurance
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.N.S. 1989, c. 293, s. 2(ad)
